headline: Product Manager | Growth & Analytics
summary: Data-driven Product Manager with a proven track record of driving user growth and improving product performance. Skilled in roadmapping, A/B testing, and stakeholder management. Passionate about leveraging user insights to create impactful products.

bullets: Led the development and launch of a new feature that increased user engagement by 25% within the first quarter.
Implemented A/B testing strategies to optimize key user flows, resulting in a 10% conversion rate improvement.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, marketing) to ensure successful product delivery and achieve business objectives.
Conducted market research and competitive analysis to identify product opportunities and inform roadmap development.
Utilized SQL to analyze user data and generate insights that informed product decisions.
Developed and presented product roadmaps to stakeholders, effectively communicating product vision and strategy.

education.institution: AGH University of Science and Technology
